title: Evidence Debt: Reproducibility Package
description: Manuscript source, deterministic simulation, canonical synthetic data, paired link-level path-survival diagnostics, and a frozen age-stratified observation of 200 merged Argo CD pull requests and 30 releases. Version 1.7.2 makes policy acceptance independent of ground truth, separates optimal Evidence Debt from policy-specific estimation, distinguishes policy abstention from physical irrecoverability, requires soundness as well as exhaustiveness before equating abstention with the physical boundary, adds a controlled reference arm to the field protocol, and evaluates a joint lambda/pi sensitivity grid. The repository observation establishes missing external issue linkage under a declared schema; it does not establish inadequate intent documentation, temporal decay, Evidence Debt magnitude, reconstruction cost, or industrial prevalence.
